data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2019 were GBP 269.922m. Movement in prior year provisions for claims outstanding produced a small favourable prior-year development of GBP 0.021m (a release), driven by low catastrophe activity in 2019 which was partly offset by reserve increases on casualty treaty / longer-tail accounts. The overall picture across lines is mixed but the aggregate prior-year movement is immaterial relative to the opening reserves.
raw_causal_phrases: The principal driver of the reduction was due to the low catastrophe activity in 2019.
This has been offset by an increase in reserves on the Casualty Treaty accounts.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Statement of Financial Position (Claims outstanding GBP 269,921k). Prior year movement (gross) taken from the 'Change in prior year provisions' row in the Technical Provisions note showing gross (21)k (i.e. a GBP 21k release). Line-of-business prior-year movements are only published net of reinsurance in the Claims Incurred note; gross movements by LOB are not provided, so LOB amounts above are based on the reported net prior year development by statutory class (used as a last-resort proxy) and therefore have lower confidence. A gross claims development triangle (gross) is present and was used as cross-check. All monetary conversions: report numbers are presented in millions (original report in GBP 000).
